description: Complete Class 11 & 12 NCERT Biology chapter summaries (32 chapters).

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Binomial nomenclature (Carolus Linnaeus), taxonomic hierarchy (Kingdom → Phylum/Division → Class → Order → Family → Genus → Species), ICBN & ICZN rules.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: R.H. Whittaker's Five Kingdom classification (Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, Animalia), Archaebacteria, Mycoplasma (smallest living cell without cell wall), viruses, viroids, prions, lichens.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Algae (Chlorophyceae, Phaeophyceae, Rhodophyceae), Bryophytes (amphibians of plant kingdom), Pteridophytes (first vascular plants), Gymnosperms (naked seeds), Angiosperms.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Levels of organisation, symmetry, coelom (acoelomate, pseudocoelomate Aschelminthes, eucoelomate), Porifera to Chordata distinguishing features (notochord, dorsal hollow nerve cord).

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Root, stem, leaf modifications, aestivation (valvate, twisted, imbricate, vexillary), placentation (marginal, axile, parietal, free central, basal), Fabaceae/Solanaceae/Liliaceae.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Meristematic & permanent tissues, xylem & phloem, vascular bundles (conjoint, radial, open/closed), dicot vs monocot root, stem, and leaf anatomy.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Animal tissues and detailed anatomy & organ systems of Frog (Rana tigrina: cutaneous & pulmonary respiration, 3-chambered heart, nucleated RBCs).

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Prokaryotic vs eukaryotic cells, endomembrane system (ER, Golgi packaging, lysosomes, vacuoles), mitochondria (70S ribosomes, circular DNA, cristae, ATP), chloroplasts, 80S cytoplasmic ribosomes.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Amino acids, lipids, polysaccharides, nucleic acids, enzymes (lock-and-key/induced fit, Km, competitive inhibition e.g. malonate on succinic dehydrogenase, cofactors/coenzymes).

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Interphase (G1, S DNA replication, G2), Mitosis (equational), Meiosis I Prophase I (Leptotene, Zygotene synapsis, Pachytene crossing over via recombinase, Diplotene chiasmata, Diakinesis).

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Light reaction (PS II P680, PS I P700, photolysis of water, non-cyclic & cyclic photophosphorylation), Calvin cycle (C3 RuBisCO), C4 Hatch-Slack pathway (PEP primary acceptor, Kranz anatomy, no photorespiration).

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Glycolysis (EMP pathway in cytoplasm, 2 net ATP), Link reaction, Krebs cycle (mitochondrial matrix), Electron Transport System (inner mitochondrial membrane, O2 final acceptor), RQ values.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Plant growth regulators: Auxin (apical dominance), Gibberellin (bolting, malting), Cytokinin (cell division, delays senescence), Ethylene (fruit ripening), Abscisic acid (stress hormone, stomatal closure).

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Respiratory volumes & capacities (TV=500 mL, VC=ERV+TV+IRV), oxygen-haemoglobin dissociation curve (sigmoid, Bohr effect), CO2 transport (70% as bicarbonate via carbonic anhydrase).

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Blood groups (ABO, Rh), coagulation cascade, human 4-chambered heart, SA node pacemaker, cardiac cycle (0.8 s, stroke volume 70 mL), ECG (P, QRS, T waves), double circulation.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Ammonotelic, ureotelic, uricotelic animals; nephron structure (PCT reabsorption, Henle's loop counter-current mechanism, DCT, collecting duct), RAAS, ADH, ANF regulation.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Skeletal muscle sarcomere (actin thin, myosin thick filaments), sliding filament theory (Ca²⁺ binds troponin, ATP hydrolysis), axial & appendicular skeleton (206 bones), joints.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Neuron structure, resting membrane potential (-70 mV), action potential (Na⁺ influx depolarisation, K⁺ efflux repolarisation), synaptic transmission, forebrain/midbrain/hindbrain functions.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Hypothalamus, pituitary (GH, PRL, TSH, ACTH, LH, FSH, oxytocin, ADH), thyroid (T3/T4), parathyroid, adrenal (epinephrine, cortisol), pancreas (insulin/glucagon), steroid vs peptide hormone action.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Microsporogenesis, megasporogenesis, 7-celled 8-nucleate Polygonum embryo sac, pollination, double fertilisation (syngamy + triple fusion forming 3n PEN), apomixis & polyembryony.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Male & female reproductive systems, spermatogenesis vs oogenesis, menstrual cycle (LH surge around day 14 triggers ovulation), fertilisation in ampullary region, implantation, placenta & parturition.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Contraceptive methods (natural, barrier, IUDs like CuT & LNG-20, oral pills, tubectomy/vasectomy), MTP, STIs, Assisted Reproductive Technologies (IVF-ET, ZIFT, GIFT, ICSI).

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Mendel's laws (3:1 monohybrid, 9:3:3:1 dihybrid), incomplete dominance (Snapdragon 1:2:1), codominance (ABO blood group), linkage & recombination, sex determination, Mendelian vs chromosomal disorders (Down, Klinefelter, Turner).

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: DNA double helix (Chargaff's rule), semi-conservative replication (Meselson & Stahl), transcription (RNA polymerase 5'→3' on 3'→5' template), genetic code (64 codons, AUG start, UAA/UAG/UGA stop), lac operon, DNA fingerprinting.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Miller-Urey experiment, homologous (divergent) vs analogous (convergent) organs, Darwin's natural selection, Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium (p² + 2pq + q² = 1), human evolution timeline.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Pathogens (Plasmodium malaria, Salmonella typhi Widal test, HIV retrovirus affecting helper T-cells), innate & acquired immunity, B/T-lymphocytes, antibodies (IgG, IgA, IgM, IgE), active vs passive immunity, cancer.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Lactobacillus curd, Saccharomyces cerevisiae baker's/brewer's yeast, Penicillium notatum antibiotic, Trichoderma cyclosporin A, Monascus statins, sewage treatment (BOD), biogas (Methanobacterium), Bt bio-control.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Restriction endonucleases (EcoRI palindromic 5'-GAATTC-3'), cloning vectors (pBR322, ori, selectable markers), agarose gel electrophoresis (ethidium bromide + UV light), PCR (denaturation, annealing, extension with Taq polymerase).

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Bt cotton (CryIAc, CryIIAb against bollworms), RNA interference (RNAi) against Meloidegyne incognita, recombinant human insulin (Eli Lilly A & B chains), ADA deficiency gene therapy, ELISA.

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Population attributes (age pyramids, natality, mortality), exponential (dN/dt = rN) vs logistic Verhulst-Pearl growth (dN/dt = rN(K-N)/K), population interactions (mutualism, commensalism, parasitism, predation, competition, amensalism).

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: GPP - R = NPP, decomposition steps, 10% energy transfer law (Lindeman), pyramid of energy is ALWAYS upright (pyramid of biomass in sea can be inverted).

passages.subject: biology
passages.content: Genetic, species, ecological diversity; latitudinal gradient; species-area relationship log S = log C + Z log A (Alexander von Humboldt); Evil Quartet (habitat loss main cause); in-situ (biosphere reserves, hotspots) vs ex-situ (seed banks, zoos).
